hero.tagline: Not sure what to read next? We have an idea

about.wideChoiceText:
We have books for every taste — from light romance to deep stories, from popular new releases to trusted classics.

Choose a genre, format, and mood — and find exactly the book you need right now.
about.promosText:
Reading more is easier than it seems.

Discounts and special offers help you discover new books more often and with more joy.
story: This site is a place where books find their readers.

We created a space that combines different reading formats, easy search, and the warm atmosphere of a library so choosing a book feels simple and enjoyable. Nothing here is random — every detail helps you find the story that speaks to you.
You can explore calmly, discover new genres, return to favorite books, or save the ones you want to come back to later. There is no rush here — only reading at your own pace.
And if you do not know where to start, that is fine too. A helpful hint is always nearby to guide you toward something new, unexpected, or exactly what you need right now.

ink.line2: and your guide to the world of books.
ink.intro: Ink is always nearby to help you find the story that fits you best.
ink.helperParagraph: Ink does not speak, but understands you: it suggests what to read, helps you search, and makes choosing easier.
ink.bellParagraph: Just tap the bell — and Ink will appear when you need help.
